flashcard_questions.q: A group of singers, actors, and instrumentalists who perform together in a stage musical.
The orchestra or band that sits in a sunken area in front of the stage and provides instrumental backing for a musical.
A musical texture where a single melody is heard with no accompaniment.

flashcard_questions.a: A musical device where one part sings or plays a phrase and another part copies it.
A texture where two or more independent melodic lines are heard at the same time.
